html:
OpenMMLab's RTMPose (t, s, m, l; 256x192 and 384x288): real-time top-down 2D human pose, a CSPNeXt CNN with a SimCC head; also the whole-body DWPose and RTMW checkpoints (133 keypoints with feet, face and hands); Halpe (26 keypoints), hand, face and animal checkpoints. Apache-2.0.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: RTMPose: Real-Time Multi-Person Pose Estimation based on MMPose, arXiv, 2023-03-13 (for rtmpose-t, rtmpose-s, rtmpose-m, rtmpose-l, rtmpose-m-384, rtmpose-l-384)
  • Paper: Effective Whole-body Pose Estimation with Two-stages Distillation, ICCV 2023 CV4Metaverse Workshop, 2023-07-29 (for dwpose-t, dwpose-s, dwpose-m, dwpose-l, dwpose-l-384)
  • Original code: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose at 5408bc76f5b8
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose/blob/5408bc76f5b848cf925a0d1857899011d8c5b497/README.md#license
  • Training data: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (body7: COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18 keypoints; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k (and on the same pose data, pt-body7))
    • dwpose-t: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (COCO-WholeBody and UBody whole-body keypoints, distilled from a larger RTMPose (DWPose two-stage distillation); the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on AI Challenger + COCO body keypoints)
    • dwpose-s: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (COCO-WholeBody and UBody whole-body keypoints, distilled from a larger RTMPose (DWPose two-stage distillation); the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on AI Challenger + COCO body keypoints)
    • dwpose-m: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (COCO-WholeBody and UBody whole-body keypoints, distilled from a larger RTMPose (DWPose two-stage distillation); the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on AI Challenger + COCO body keypoints)
    • dwpose-l: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (COCO-WholeBody and UBody whole-body keypoints, distilled from a larger RTMPose (DWPose two-stage distillation); the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on AI Challenger + COCO body keypoints)
    • dwpose-l-384: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (COCO-WholeBody and UBody whole-body keypoints, distilled from a larger RTMPose (DWPose two-stage distillation); the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on AI Challenger + COCO body keypoints)
    • rtmw-m: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (Cocktail14: AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18, COCO-WholeBody, UBody, Human-Art, WFLW, 300W, COFW, LaPa and InterHand2.6M (the last six are not in the dataset list; several are research-only), distilled from RTMW-l; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body / whole-body keypoints)
    • rtmw-l: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (Cocktail14: AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18, COCO-WholeBody, UBody, Human-Art, WFLW, 300W, COFW, LaPa and InterHand2.6M (the last six are not in the dataset list; several are research-only), distilled from RTMW-x; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body / whole-body keypoints)
    • rtmw-x: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (Cocktail14: AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18, COCO-WholeBody, UBody, Human-Art, WFLW, 300W, COFW, LaPa and InterHand2.6M (the last six are not in the dataset list; several are research-only); the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body / whole-body keypoints)
    • rtmw-l-384: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (Cocktail14: AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18, COCO-WholeBody, UBody, Human-Art, WFLW, 300W, COFW, LaPa and InterHand2.6M (the last six are not in the dataset list; several are research-only), distilled from RTMW-x; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body / whole-body keypoints)
    • rtmw-x-384: COCO-WholeBody, UBody (upper-body whole-body keypoints, from OSX), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (Cocktail14: AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18, COCO-WholeBody, UBody, Human-Art, WFLW, 300W, COFW, LaPa and InterHand2.6M (the last six are not in the dataset list; several are research-only); the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body / whole-body keypoints)
    • rtmpose-t-halpe26: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (body7 with the 26 Halpe keypoints (COCO-WholeBody feet annotations for COCO): COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body7)
    • rtmpose-s-halpe26: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (body7 with the 26 Halpe keypoints (COCO-WholeBody feet annotations for COCO): COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body7)
    • rtmpose-m-halpe26: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (body7 with the 26 Halpe keypoints (COCO-WholeBody feet annotations for COCO): COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body7)
    • rtmpose-l-halpe26: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (body7 with the 26 Halpe keypoints (COCO-WholeBody feet annotations for COCO): COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body7)
    • rtmpose-m-halpe26-384: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (body7 with the 26 Halpe keypoints (COCO-WholeBody feet annotations for COCO): COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body7)
    • rtmpose-l-halpe26-384: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (body7 with the 26 Halpe keypoints (COCO-WholeBody feet annotations for COCO): COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body7)
    • rtmpose-x-halpe26-384: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018, ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (body7 with the 26 Halpe keypoints (COCO-WholeBody feet annotations for COCO): COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18; the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on body7)
    • rtmpose-m-hand5: COCO-WholeBody, Halpe-FullBody, COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification) (hand5: COCO-WholeBody-Hand, OneHand10K, FreiHAND, RHD and Halpe hands (OneHand10K, FreiHAND and RHD are not in the dataset list; research-only terms); the CSPNeXt backbone was pre-trained on ImageNet-1k and on AI Challenger + COCO body keypoints)

  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: rtmpose-t, rtmpose-s, rtmpose-m, rtmpose-l, rtmpose-m-384, rtmpose-l-384, dwpose-t, dwpose-s, dwpose-m, dwpose-l, dwpose-l-384, rtmw-m, rtmw-l, rtmw-x, rtmw-l-384, rtmw-x-384, rtmpose-t-halpe26, rtmpose-s-halpe26, rtmpose-m-halpe26, rtmpose-l-halpe26, rtmpose-m-halpe26-384, rtmpose-l-halpe26-384, rtmpose-x-halpe26-384, rtmpose-m-hand5, rtmpose-t-face6, rtmpose-s-face6, rtmpose-m-face6, rtmpose-m-ap10k
